text:
Alyssa: Quick sync — we need a final copy pass for Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing pages + webinar hook + inbound lead routing. Goal: one-week turnaround. Thoughts?

Omar: +1. Can we try a single hero framework (who, benefit, CTA) and micro-variants per mode? e.g., 'Run high-performance LLMs anywhere — hosted for speed, dedicated for predictability, private for compliance.'

Priya: Love that. Keep verbs tangible. Suggest micro-lines: Hosted = 'Start with a hosted API — responses in <100ms', Dedicated = 'Reserved GPU pools for steady throughput', Private = 'Bring inference behind your VPC with audits & KMS'.

Ethan: For the webinar hook — "Live: Cut inference cost while meeting latency SLOs". We should tease a benchmark (cost/token vs latency) and a short demo.

Marta: Landing visuals idea: a 3-card comparison (hosted / dedicated / private) + one-liner under each. Can I get final micro-copy by Tuesday so I can mock?

Alyssa: Also need inbound lead routing matrix:
- self-serve signups -> marketing automation / nurture
- demo requests or >$X committed/month -> sales AE queue
- security or private deployment interest -> solutions engineering + security SME
@LaunchBot can you add tag templates? :point_down:

LaunchBot: Noted. Will add tags: 'tier:self-serve', 'need-sla', 'private-deploy-interest'. I can also auto-route demo requests to sales if more than Y seats.

Omar: A/B test plan: Variant A = 'Economics' (cost per token, Optimize tips), Variant B = 'Reliability' (SLA, fallbacks, dedicated guarantees). Primary metrics: demo requests, webinar signups, MQL conversion.

Priya: Draft hero lines for review (short+clear):
- Hosted: 'Ship fast with a hosted API — production LLMs in minutes.'
- Dedicated: 'Predictable performance with reserved GPU capacity.'
- Private: 'Full control and audited deployments behind your VPC.'
I'll drop these into the doc with alt phrasings.

Ethan: I'll produce 3 headline + subhead options per mode and a short benchmark blurb: 'Benchmark snapshot: standard LLM — median latency ~80ms on hosted; dedicated enables ~3x throughput under batch; private meets enterprise compliance requirements.' Need final numbers from eng for copy accuracy.

Alyssa: Action items:
- Priya: finalize micro-copy by Mon EOD
- Marta: 3-card mock by Tue
- Ethan: headline options + benchmark blurb by Wed
- Omar: A/B test config and tracking plan by Wed
- LaunchBot: add lead tags and routing templates today
Ping me if anyone is blocked. :rocket:

Omar: Added the tracking sheet and tagging spec to the project board. Will sync with analytics tomorrow.

Marta: Starting mocks now — will post first pass in #design by 11am PT tomorrow.

Priya: I'll iterate the micro-copy and post a doc link later today for quick comments.

Ethan: On it — reaching out to eng for latency/throughput numbers.

Alyssa: Awesome team — thanks. If we can get the copy locked this week we can push the webinar landing + email sequence next week. :white_check_mark:
